analytics.subtitle: Uburyo butike igenda. Hitamo igihe maze urebe imibare vuba.
analytics.customDatesHint: Hitamo "Hitamo igihe" hamwe n'amatariki kugira ngo urebe igihe runaka. Niba utabikoze, igihe gihitamo nicyo gikoreshwa.
analytics.salesByDayHint: Hitamo umunsi mwiza n'umunsi muke kugira ngo umenye uko bigenda.
analytics.expensesHint: Aho amafaranga menshi yagiye muri iki gihe.

analytics.currentCostNote: Igiciro cy'ibyacurujwe gikoresha igiciro cyanditswe igihe cyo kugurisha. Ibyagurishijwe mbere ya Nyakanga 2026 bikoresha igiciro cy'ubu nk'igenekereje.
analytics.noSalesHint: Iyo ibyacurujwe bigeze, igishushanyo kizagaragara hano.
analytics.profitByProductHint: Icyo buri gicuruzwa cyinjije nyuma yo gukuramo igiciro, bitondekanyije ku nyungu. Icyatsi ≥15%, umuhondo 5–15%, umutuku munsi ya 5%.

restock.title: Gahunda yo kongera ububiko
restock.subtitle: Ibitumizwa bishingiye ku muvuduko w'ibicuruzwa byawe: impuzandengo y'iminsi {burnDays} ishize, tugamije iminsi {coverDays} y'ububiko. Bizamurwa ku makarito yuzuye.
restock.editHint: Ibitumizwa byujujwe mbere — hindura amakarito cyangwa igiciro bihuze n'uwo mugurana, igiteranyo kihindura ako kanya.
restock.scopeNote: Umuvuduko ntumira ibicuruzwa bitagurishijwe mu gihe — ibidakoreshwa ntibizatuma hatumizwa. Ibiciro bikoresha igiciro cy'ubu.
restock.draftErrorNoLines: Nta gitumizwa — banza ushyire amakarito ku gicuruzwa nibura kimwe.
restock.draftErrorNoSupplier: Hitamo uwo mugurana iri tumiza rigenewe.
restock.draftNote: Byakozwe biva muri gahunda yo kongera ububiko
restock.draftHint: Bihindura urutonde rwo hejuru umushinga w'itumiza. Uzarusuzuma ku rupapuro rw'amatumiza, urwemeze igihe ibicuruzwa bigeze — ni bwo ububiko n'ibiciro byandikwa.

treasury.title: Amafaranga ahari
treasury.subtitle: Amafaranga mu isanduku hamwe na MoMo na banki — ayo ushobora gukoresha mu itumiza.
treasury.transferReferencePlaceholder: Nomero ya resi ya MoMo, urupapuro rwa banki…
treasury.transferHint: Byandika amafaranga yavuye mu isanduku ajya kuri MoMo cyangwa muri banki. Gufunga isanduku bizitega amafaranga make, bityo iyimurwa ntirisome nk'ibura.
treasury.checkpointHint: Reba konti yawe ya MoMo cyangwa banki maze wandike umubare uriho ubu. Kuva ubwo sisitemu izawukurikirana yonyine (ibyinjiye, ibisohotse, ibyimuwe). Wongere uwushyireho igihe ubigereranyije.

salesHistory.title: Amateka y'ibicuruzwa
salesHistory.subtitle: Buri gicuruzwa n'inyungu yacyo. Kanda ku gicuruzwa urebe imbonerahamwe.
salesHistory.scopeNote: Herekana ibicuruzwa 100 biheruka. Inyungu ikoresha igiciro cyanditswe igihe cyo kugurisha.
salesHistory.approximateCostNote: * Igiciro kuri iyi ligne ni igenekereje — igicuruzwa cyabaye mbere y'uko sisitemu yandika ibiciro.

stockTake.title: Kubara ububiko
stockTake.subtitle: Bara ibiri ku gakaramu, wandike itandukaniro ku byo bitajya. Impinduka zandikwa mu ububiko hamwe n'impamvu "Itandukaniro ryo kubara".
stockTake.notePlaceholder: Urugero: Kubara kw'ukwezi, gufunga ku cyumweru, ibyamenetse ejo…
stockTake.noteHint: Sobanura impamvu wabaze uyu munsi. Bisigara kuri buri mpinduka kugira ngo bizere mu bihe biri imbere.
stockTake.errorAllRequired: Bara buri gicuruzwa mbere yo kubika. Andika 0 mu makarito cyangwa bicye ku bidafite.
stockTake.scopeNote: Impinduka zandikwa mu ububiko hamwe n'impamvu "Itandukaniro ryo kubara" na ID yawe.
stockTake.historyEmpty: Nta kubara biranditse. Ibya mbere bizagaragara hano.

register.subtitle: Buri gitumizwa na buri gicuruzwa mu gihe, hamwe n'ibiteranyo — cyateguriwe umubaruramari. Kuramo buri mbonerahamwe muri CSV ya Excel.
register.summaryHint: Ibyaguzwe n'ibyagurishijwe kuri buri gicuruzwa, n'inyungu.
register.salesHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nta murongo} =1 {Umurongo #} other {Imirongo #}} mu gihe, umurongo kuri buri gicuruzwa muri buri gurisha.
register.purchasesHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nta murongo} =1 {Umurongo #} other {Imirongo #}} — amatumiza yakiriwe gusa.
register.scopeNote: Ikiguzi cy'ibyagurishijwe gikoresha igiciro cyanditswe igihe cyo kugurisha. Amatumiza akubiyemo ayakiriwe gusa — imishinga n'ayahagaritswe ntabwo abarirwamo.

reports.title: Inyandiko y'umunsi
reports.subtitle: Ibyacurujwe, amafaranga, ibyacurutswe cyane — ku munsi.
reports.emptyExpenses: Nta mafaranga yasohotse kuri uyu munsi.
reports.emptySessions: Nta bisanduku byakoreshejwe kuri uyu munsi.

coupons.title: Amakuponi
coupons.subtitle: Tanga kode zo kugabanya igiciro zikoreshwa rimwe. Sangiza umukiriya kode (WhatsApp, urupapuro); umucuruzi ayandika ku kwishyura.
coupons.emptyHint: Kora ikuponi uhe umukiriya igabanya ry'igiciro rikoreshwa rimwe.
coupons.confirmRevoke: Kuraho iyi kuponi? Kode izahita ireka gukora.

form.newSubtitle: Shyiraho igabanuka, sangiza umukiriya kode, umucuruzi ayandika ku kwishyura.
form.perUnitHint: Shyiraho akamenyetso niba igabanuka rigomba kuva kuri buri kintu — urugero: "700 RWF kuri buri cupa" ku macupa 100 ni 70,000 RWF yose. Bitabaye ibyo, igabanuka rikurwa rimwe ku byaguzwe byose.
form.productHint: Igabanuka rusange rikora ku byaguzwe byose; ikuponi igenewe igicuruzwa ikora kuri icyo gusa.
form.belowCostWarn: Icyitonderwa — igiciro cya nyuma kiri munsi y'ikiguzi. Umucuruzi ntazashobora kuyikoresha utabanje gushyiraho "Kwemera kurenga umusingi" hano hepfo.
form.codePlaceholder: Siga ubusa ikorwe mu buryo bwikora
form.codeHint: Kode zikorwa mu buryo bwikora zigira inyuguti 6 kandi zirinda inyuguti zisa (0/O/I/1). Kode yihariye igomba kugira inyuguti cyangwa imibare 4–20.
form.notePlaceholder: Iyi ni iya nde? (Umuguzi mukuru Jean-Paul …)
form.floorOverrideHint: Ituma iyi kuponi ikoreshwa n'ubwo yarenga inyungu ntarengwa (byandikwa mu gitabo). Ikoreshwe ku kurangiza stock cyangwa ku mugambi wihariye.
